# GuideLink v0.1.7

Sky UK source refreshes now support ViewersVault's current region tables. Failed
refreshes are reported as failed even when GuideLink can retain a last-good cache.

## Fixes

- Parse ViewersVault's region-number key and country channel matrix, including
  the regional BBC and ITV/STV/UTV services. Existing region formats remain
  supported. Ambiguous or incomplete region data still fails validation.
- Mark both individual and profile-batch refreshes as failed when fetching or
  parsing fails and an old cache is retained. Results keep the source error,
  original fetch time and fallback details, so an old cache no longer looks like
  a successful update. Other profiles in a batch continue processing.
- Preserve the last-good cache and existing source-failure alerts without
  generating a duplicate generic failure alert for the same source error.

## Upgrade

Install `guidelink.zip` through the
[reviewed update flow](https://github.com/djrarky/GuideLink/blob/v0.1.7/docs/INSTALL.md#update-an-existing-install).
Profiles, assignments and caches are preserved; no schema migration, new profile
field or host code change is required.

Run **Refresh Source Cache** after updating to replace an outdated ViewersVault
lineup. Source refresh remains separate from playlist sync. Historical run
statuses are unchanged; the corrected failure status applies to new refreshes.

Bundled-alias target validation is unchanged in this release. An outdated alias
target can still block playlist sync even after a successful source refresh.

Download `guidelink.zip` for installation. `SHA256SUMS` verifies the assets and
`release.json` records the packaged file hashes.

## Validation

- All **267 plugin tests (1,877 assertions)** passed on SQLite with PHP 8.4.16
  against m3u-editor host commit `50791fc8b` (Laravel 13.42).
- Standalone plugin validation, formatting checks for changed PHP files, and all
  nine release-tool tests passed.
- The packaged 0.1.6-to-0.1.7 update passed reviewed installation, trust and
  integrity checks on an existing host using its configured fake scanner.
  Profiles and assignments were verified unchanged, and workers were reloaded.
- A live Sky Region-7 refresh fetched **298 channels** from ViewersVault without
  stale fallback, including the current Sky Cinema Spider-Man name at 303.
- Regression coverage includes country and local-feed selection, ambiguous and
  missing region data, retained-cache failure status, shared-source batches,
  independent profile success, cache preservation and alert deduplication.

The live check covered an existing installation and source refresh. First-run
browser setup and playlist mapping were not retested for this update.
